is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles funestus s.s. and Anopheles gambiae mosquitoes (Section 2.1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study genotypes Vgsc L1014F (kdr), Rdl A296S, and GSTe2 L119F (Section 2.7, 3.6.1, 3.6.2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Genotype counts and frequencies are provided for RDL-A296S (160 RR, 24 SS out of 190), GSTe2-L119F (11 RR, 35 RS, 27 SS out of 73), and kdr (56 RR, 4 RS out of 60) in sections 3.6.1 and 3.6.2.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in the locality of Elon, Central Cameroon (Section 2.1).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study reporting original collection, bioassay, and genotyping data.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study provides the specific locality: Elon (N4.23051° E11.60120°) (Section 2.1).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper describes a routine new collection in Elon, Cameroon in 2018.

supplement.evidence: All extractable genotype data for the target markers is contained within the main text (Sections 3.6.1 and 3.6.2).

assessment.summary: This study investigates the expression of D7 salivary genes in pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles funestus and Anopheles gambiae from Elon, Cameroon. It reports genotype frequencies for Vgsc L1014F, Rdl A296S, and GSTe2 L119F in field-collected populations from 2018.
